records.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit attached six-frame overhead iron recurve archer atlas with THREE exact cleanup fixes. 1) Frames1/2/3: ERASE COMPLETELY the faint old horizontal bowstring stretched straight between bowtips. It must be absent, no ghost transparency or faded line. Keep ONLY two drawn-string segments meeting at arrow nock/drawing fingers. 2) Frame1 rightward string crosses screen-right forearm, and frames2/3 rightward string crosses upper exposed bow arm/red sleeve/iron shoulder plate. String runs BEHIND the shooting arm: string must be HIDDEN wherever any skin, sleeve, shoulder plate or wristguard is in front of it. Restore clean original skin/armor pixels across the line intersection. Visible string segment stops at arm silhouette then resumes on opposite side along same straight line. Absolutely NO thin bright line drawn on top of arm/armor. Keep string endpoints at bow tips, apex attached to rear arrow nock at drawing fingers. 3) Frame5 BOTTOM MIDDLE: retain ONE horizontal recurve bow across lowerfront, held by screen-right bowhand. Remove any additional vertical curved wood limb/staff beside arm/rightward of hand, repaint exposed background transparent and restore hand/forearm. Singlebow with2tips1grip1string only. Frame4 bottomleft: retain its current singlebow and string, no extraobjects. All six frames onebowonly. Preserve existing perfectly verticalscreen-down straightarrow1/2/3, arrowabsent4/5/6. Keep exact pose anatomy costume camera cells scale identity and all unrelated pixels. Same1536x1024RGBA3columns2rows512cells, actualalpha0 outside sprites, no background/shadow/text. This is localcleanup, do not generate different poses. Most critical inspectable rule: NO horizontal line between bowtips in drawn frames and NO string OVER shootingarm; drawnstring OCCLUDED by skin/armor.
